target: Neural Bellman Operators: primitive-only work schedules and recursive entropic full-policy certificates
primary_estimand: Deterministic success and operation/check counts over the entire declared catalogue, together with an explicit real-arithmetic primitive-only upper work account. Measured clocks describe these executions, not population expected runtimes.
freeze: Code, parameters, comparison methods and failure rules are committed before any primary dimension-10 or dimension-50 fit. Development tests use only dimensions at most 3 and horizon at most 5.
failure_rule: One capped attempt per service. Retain every exception, failed training threshold and failed final certificate. No unrecorded rescue, tolerance change or selected deletion.
information: All methods receive identical analytic own-policy Gaussian evaluation information. No optimal-policy labels enter a neural fit or the common verifier.
cost: Initialization, allocation, all fitting, all inner checks, action construction, full-policy verification, candidate compression and durable candidate/attempt writes. Common imports and final aggregation are separate whole-job overhead. Operation counts are declared algebraic counters, not hardware instructions.
interpretation: The nonlinear aggregator is a recursive entropic capital cost, not a claim to have instantiated every recursive utility or game in the applications companion. All future controls are reoptimized. Structural comparisons and adverse cost results are retained. No empirical calibration or neural cost dominance is assumed.
